syllabus_topics: Introduction. Process analysis - object of automatization.
Design sequence and types of tasks when designing automatization devices.
Design of composition, synchronization of movements and development of kinematical schemes.
Functions of mechanisms and choice of the law of movement.
Mechanisms for progressive, cyclic, and interrupted movement.
Choice of methods and means for automatic manipulation.
Manufacturing manipulators and miniature product robots.
Group machining and product assembly devices.
assessment_rules: The exam grade is based on two written answers and a discussion of all the theoretical material from the lectures. A course project is optional.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
